description: Submit an application for a contractor, trade, home builder, architect/engineer, lender, agent/broker, property manager or supplier to join the TBG network in Maryland. Accepted only with user_consented=true (the applicant agrees to be contacted about joining).

assistant_name.description: Name of the AI assistant or app submitting, e.g. "Claude", "ChatGPT", "Gemini".

license_info.description: MHIC, trade license or NMLS numbers.

service_areas.description: e.g. Anne Arundel County, Annapolis (city), Howard County.

user_consented.description: True only if the applicant agreed that TBG may contact them about joining the network.
